sentences.text: Blapl No. 1138 of 2023
Hussain Ansari and another .... Petitioners

Mr. B.K. Ragada, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party
 Mr. K.K. Gaya, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
21.02.2023 Order No.
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioners are accused in G.R. Case No.4846 of 2022, pending in the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Sambalpur, arising out of Thelkoli P.S. Case No.0297 of 2022 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 403/408/420/120-B/34 of IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge, Sambalpur by order dated 21.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. The allegation against the present petitioners is that they along with other co-accused surreptitiously substitute coal by ass.

5. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners that the co-accused similarly circumstanced have since been released on bail by this Court by order dated 03.01.2023 and in BLAPL No.12926 of 2022 and another co- accused has been released on anticipatory bail by order dated 22.12.2022 in ABLAPL No.15999 of 2022.
Hence, he seeks release of the petitioners on the ground of parity.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail inter alia on the ground that the petitioners do not belong to the State of Odisha.
Hence his presence at the trial could not be ensure.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the nature of allegation, the punishment prescribed and as the petitioners are stated to be in custody since 04.12.2022, this Court directs the petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

8. To allay the legitimate concern expressed by the learned counsel for the State that the presence of the petitioner cannot be secured as he is from outside State, it is directed that in addition to the sureties one of the sureties shall be immediate member of the family who shall execute a P.R. bond.

9. Before releasing the petitioners, learned Court in seisin is called upon to obtain instruction regarding the criminal antecedent of Petitioner No.1 from Palajori Police Station, Dist-Deogarh (Jharkhand) and Petitioner No.2 from Kona police station, Dist-Sonbhadra, State-Uttar Pradesh of similar nature.
If it comes to the fore that the petitioners have any such criminal antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.

10. Additionally it is directed that the petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till submission of final form and certification of such appearance shall be submitted before the learned Court in seisin.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
